name: Any model
summary: The stack doesn't depend on one model. You choose the provider and model in configuration, through a direct API, a model gateway or a local runtime, and can switch without changing the agent.
how: The harness talks to models through a provider-neutral client or an OpenAI-compatible API
You set the provider, model and key in config or at runtime
Fallbacks and routing, if any, come from the model gateway layer
facts: Works with models from many providers; none is required
Stacks whose docs say they support any provider
Behaviour, tool-calling quality and cost vary by the model you choose
goodFor: Switching models as prices and quality change
Running open-weight models locally or in the cloud
watchOut: Agents tuned on one model family can behave differently on another
